examples.target: 그럼 왜 내가 같이 못 가는데?
examples.native: Then why can't I come with you?

examples.target: 나중에 톰에 대해 말해줄 것이 있다.
examples.native: I have something to tell you about Tom later.
What is there for me to say?
It was worth coming this far.

examples.target: 그는 한 가지 언어만 말할 수 있다.
examples.native: He can only speak one language.

examples.target: 톰은 매리와 같은 속도로 빠르게 달릴 수 있다.
examples.native: Tom can run as fast as Mary.
I think I heard the game!
I think she might change her mind.

examples.target: 난 톰과 메리가 맞는 것 같다.
examples.native: I think Tom and Mary are right.
I have a cute side too.
I've been in this situation before.
I want to do it too.

examples.target: 나는 톰과 그 친구들과 재밌는 시간을 보냈다.
examples.native: I had a great time with Tom and his friends.
